title: Q1. Print Balanced Parentheses
statement:
Given n pairs of parentheses (so n=3 produces arrangements such as ((())), not n=6), print every balanced arrangement using exactly n opening and n closing parentheses. Print one arrangement per line; any order is accepted.

Input: n, the number of pairs. Output: all balanced arrangements, one per line.

title: Q2. Print Ways to Climb n Steps
statement:
You can climb either 1 or 2 steps at a time. Print every sequence of steps that reaches exactly n steps, one sequence per line. Separate numbers by spaces; any order is accepted.

Input: n. Output: all valid sequences.

title: Q3. Josephus Survivor
statement:
n people stand in a circle, numbered 1 to n. Starting from person 1, eliminate every k-th remaining person until one survivor remains. Print the survivor's position (1-indexed).

Input: n k.

title: Q4. Bank Account Hacks
statement:
You start with 1 rupee. A hack may multiply your amount by 10 or by 20. Each hack can be used any number of times. Print Yes if exactly N rupees can be reached, otherwise print No.

Input: N.

title: Q5. Find a Path in a Maze
statement: Given an N x N grid where 1 is open and 0 is blocked, start at (0,0) and reach (N-1,N-1). You may move up, down, left, or right. Print Yes if a path exists, otherwise No.
